run_text_completion: run the Llama model to generate text completions for a list of prompts using fire CLI
build_llama_generator: build a Llama generator from checkpoint and tokenizer paths with configurable sequence length and batch size
run_text_completion_with_temperature: run text completion with custom temperature and top-p sampling parameters for controlled randomness
run_few_shot_translation: run few-shot translation prompts through the Llama model to translate English to French
run_batch_text_completion: run batch text completion on multiple prompts with configurable max generation length and batch size
